home_controller.dart:368-371 `var permission = await location.checkPermission(); if (permission == LocationPermission.denied) { permission = await location.requestPermission(); }`
home.dart:266-267 `} else if (_currentLatLng == null) { _detectCurrentAddress(); }`
suggested_fix: Stop retrying when the first attempt ended in a permission failure (track the last DetectedLocation.failure), and on resume only re-detect when the last state was not permissionRequired.

title: Late first GPS fix glides whichever map is on top (pickup / Set pickup / Select ride), not Home's
description: _runDetectCurrentAddress ends with `AppScope.instance.maps.animateCamera(target, zoom: homeOpeningZoom, follow: true)` with no check that Home's map is the active owner. While Home is parked (NAV-3 or _withParkedHomeMap) its controller is detached (home.dart:233) and GoogleMapProvider.controller returns `_owners.last.controller` (google_map_provider.dart:24-25), i.e. the map of ConfirmPickupSpot (owner 'pickup', confirm_pickup_spot.dart:333), SetPickupPage (set_pickup_page.dart:870) or SelectRide. _mayMove(map, follow:true) only checks heldByRider (google_map_provider.dart:79-85), so the booking screen's camera eases to the rider's GPS point at zoom 11.7. The sibling path _centerCameraOnQuickFix explicitly guards `if (maps.activeOwner != MapOwners.home) return;` (home.dart:312), showing this guard was intended. detectCurrent can take up to 16 s (detectFixTimeout) while _awaitCurrentFix gives up after 8 s and the flow continues with the fallback pickup, so the fix routinely lands after the rider is on a map screen.
failure_scenario: Cold start on web/Safari, slow first fix. Rider taps Where to, picks a destination; _awaitCurrentFix times out at 8 s, SelectRide opens, rider taps Book, Set pickup opens with the fallback pin. At ~12 s the fix lands: Set pickup's camera glides to the GPS point at city zoom 11.7; onCameraMove recomputes _center, _onCameraIdle sets _routeStart/_usable=true, re-resolves the address and re-quotes. The pickup silently moved under the rider; in ConfirmPickupSpot the pin likewise jumps and the shown address changes.
evidence:
home.dart:395-399 `await AppScope.instance.maps.animateCamera(GeoPoint(target.latitude, target.longitude), zoom: homeOpeningZoom, follow: true);`
home.dart:311-312 `// Map not created yet: onMapCreated picks the hint up.` / `if (maps.activeOwner != MapOwners.home) return;` (quick fix is guarded, accurate fix is not)
google_map_provider.dart:24-25 `GoogleMapController? get controller => _owners.isEmpty ? null : _owners.last.controller;`
google_map_provider.dart:81 `if (follow) return !view.heldByRider;`
suggested_fix: In _runDetectCurrentAddress skip the animateCamera when `_mapParked.value || AppScope.instance.maps.activeOwner != MapOwners.home` (onMapCreated already re-centres from _currentLatLng when Home's map comes back).

title: Geocoder failure after the route picker closes silently drops the booking (unhandled async error)
description: After RoutePickerPage pops with a draft, _showRouteAddressPicker runs `Future.wait([_normaliseAddress(rawPickup...), _normaliseAddress(rawDestination...), ...])`. HomeLocationController.normaliseAddress calls `geocoding.forward(clean)` with no try/catch (home_controller.dart:258); AppGeocoding._forwardFromApi does `api.post(...).timeout(requestTimeout)` and ApiClient._send throws ApiError on HTTP >= 400, NETWORK and TIMEOUT (api_client.dart:98, 123, 131). The exception propagates through _handleDestinationTap -> _runRouteFlow (finally only resets the flag) -> WhereToCard.onTap, which is a VoidCallback, so it becomes an unhandled zone error. Nothing is shown to the rider, nothing is persisted and SelectRide never opens. The picker itself catches onFinish failures (route_picker_page.dart:408-411) but this post-pop step does not. Same unguarded pattern: _useSavedPlaceAsDestination (home.dart:545), _saveAddressFor (home.dart:469, 477), PickupMapController.search used by ConfirmPickupSpot._lookup (confirm_pickup_spot.dart:286) and SetPickupPage._searchAddress (set_pickup_page.dart:702).
failure_scenario: Rider is offline or the geocode endpoint times out. They pick pickup and destination in the route picker (onFinish succeeds because resolvePlace is cached or the point came with the suggestion), the picker closes, the forward geocode of the raw strings throws, the flow aborts: Home shows the old sheet, no error, no SelectRide, Recents not updated. Tapping a saved place (Home/Work card) while offline likewise does nothing.
evidence:
home.dart:952-959 `final normaliseBatch = _locationCtl.beginNormalisationBatch(); final normalizedRoute = await Future.wait<String>([ _normaliseAddress(rawPickup, generation: normaliseBatch), ...`
home_controller.dart:258 `final result = await geocoding.forward(clean);` (no try/catch)
api_client.dart:122-123 `if (response.statusCode >= 400) { throw _errorFromResponse(response, requestId); }` and :131 `throw ApiError(code: 'TIMEOUT', ...)`
where_to_card.dart:25 `final VoidCallback onDestinationTap;` (future dropped)
suggested_fix: Wrap the post-pop normalisation (and the saved-place / favourite / pickup-search paths) in try/catch; on failure fall back to the raw strings (the draft already carries pickupLat/Lng and destinationLat/Lng) or show homeChooseValidRoute / routeCouldNotReach, instead of letting the exception escape.

title: 'Use current location' row saves the placeholder 'Location off, set pickup' as Home/Work and into Recents
description: When location is off/denied, _runDetectCurrentAddress and _resetPickupLabel set _pickupAddress = locationOffPickupLabel. _placeOrNull only filters '' and 'Current location' (home.dart:524-528), so in _showAddressPicker the 'Use current location' row is enabled and pops that placeholder string; _saveAddressFor normalises it and applyResolved stores it as homeAddress/workAddress and calls remember(address), whose own filter also only knows 'Current location' (home_places_controller.dart:86). Home's _rememberAddress guard (isPlaceholderPickupLabel, home.dart:449) is bypassed on this path. Reproduced: applyResolved(target:'home', address: locationOffPickupLabel) -> `home=Location off, set pickup recents=[Location off, set pickup]`.
failure_scenario: Location services off. Rider long-presses the Home card, sees 'Use current location' with subtitle 'Location off, set pickup', taps it: Home address becomes 'Location off, set pickup', it shows on the Home card and in Recents, and tapping the Home card later feeds that text to the geocoder as a destination.
evidence:
home.dart:1211-1216 `onTap: _placeOrNull(_pickupAddress) == null ? null : () => Navigator.pop(sheetContext, _placeOrNull(_pickupAddress)),`
home.dart:524-528 `String? _placeOrNull(String? address) { final value = address?.trim() ?? ''; if (value.isEmpty || value == 'Current location') return null; return value; }`
home_places_controller.dart:84-86 `void remember(String address) { final clean = address.trim(); if (clean.isEmpty || clean == 'Current location') return;`
suggested_fix: Use isPlaceholderPickupLabel (and isUnusablePickupLabel) in _placeOrNull / the row's enabled check, and have HomePlacesController.remember reject placeholder and raw-coordinate labels like Home._rememberAddress does.

title: Recenter button is hidden after a recenter that was interrupted or blocked, leaving the map off the rider with no way back
description: _recenterOnUser unconditionally ends with `setState(() => _showRecenterButton = false)`. The flight future completes early when a finger touches the map (MapView.touching -> interrupt() completes _done, map_camera_motion.dart:76-94), and the refinement glide `_flyToUser(fresh, follow: true)` is a no-op when heldByRider (google_map_provider.dart:81, 102). In both cases the camera is not on the rider, any 'show' decision made by _handleMapCameraMove during the rider's pan is overwritten with false, and the button only returns after the next camera move event.
failure_scenario: Rider taps recenter; while latestFix() runs (up to 9 s) they pan the map elsewhere (button correctly shows). latestFix returns a point >15 m away, the follow glide is refused because the map is held, then _showRecenterButton = false: the map stays where they panned and the recenter button is gone until they move the map again.
evidence:
home.dart:1664-1668 `await _flyToUser(fresh, follow: known != null); } else { await flight; } if (mounted) setState(() => _showRecenterButton = false);`
map_camera_motion.dart:306 `if (view.touching) return Future<void>.value();`
google_map_provider.dart:102 `if (map == null || !_mayMove(map, follow)) return;`
suggested_fix: Only clear _showRecenterButton when the glide actually landed (e.g. re-evaluate with AppScope.instance.camera.showRecenter against the last camera pose), or leave it to _handleMapCameraMove.

title: Chat message times use the Material 12/24-hour locale default instead of the app's 24-hour rule
description: _messageTime formats with `TimeOfDay.fromDateTime(sentAt.toLocal()).format(context)`, which follows MaterialLocalizations.timeOfDayFormat: for the 'en' locale that is 'h:mm a' (12-hour, '3:05 PM') unless MediaQuery.alwaysUse24HourFormat is set. Every other time in the app is forced to 24-hour ('08:05') by L10n.formatTime (l10n.dart:111-114, 'as Movera shows it in every language') and ReservationFormat.time, so a rider using English in Sweden sees '3:05 PM' on chat bubbles but '15:05' on the Waiting sheet and notifications for the same moment.
failure_scenario: Rider with app language EN opens the driver chat: bubbles show '3:05 PM' while the ride sheet shows 'Pickup 15:05'.
suggested_fix: Use L10n.formatTime(sentAt.toLocal()) in chat.dart.

title: Hard-coded English UI strings in localized screens (notification toast, account security errors)
description: The app ships en/fr/sv (`L10n.languages`) and every other user-facing string on these screens goes through `context.l10n`. These do not: `MoveraToast.show(context, 'This ride has ended.')` shown when a notification row's ride can no longer be opened (154); `errorMessage = 'Account security is unavailable right now.'` and `'Could not update active sessions.'` (account_security_controller.dart:240, 265) which `SecurityPage` renders directly (security.dart:924, 1090). A Swedish or French rider sees English here.
failure_scenario: App language Svenska; rider taps an old ride notification: toast reads "This ride has ended." in English. Security page fails to load: "Account security is unavailable right now." in English.
evidence:
notification_navigation.dart:154 `MoveraToast.show(context, 'This ride has ended.');`
account_security_controller.dart:240 `errorMessage = 'Account security is unavailable right now.';`
account_security_controller.dart:265 `errorMessage = 'Could not update active sessions.';`
security.dart:924 `body: _security.errorMessage ?? context.l10n.securityUnavailableBody,`
suggested_fix: Add ARB keys and use `L10n.current`/`context.l10n` for these three strings.

title: Notification day label uses local-midnight Duration.inDays, which is 0 across the spring-forward day, so yesterday's notifications are labelled as today
description: _formatTime computes `today.difference(day).inDays` where both are local midnights built with DateTime(y,m,d). On the day after a spring-forward transition the two midnights are 23 hours apart (verified by throwaway test under TZ=Europe/Stockholm: DateTime(2026,3,30).difference(DateTime(2026,3,29)) == 23:00:00), so inDays == 0 and the function returns only the clock, dropping the 'Yesterday' prefix the FLOW-18 comment promises. More generally, any day count across a DST change is one short (a notification from 3 days ago reads as 2 days -> still fine, but 2 days ago reads as 1 -> 'Yesterday').
failure_scenario: Sunday 29 Mar 2026 (Europe/Stockholm) at 23:10 a 'Driver arrived' push arrives. On Monday 30 Mar the Notifications list shows it as '23:10' (today) instead of 'Yesterday 23:10'; a push from Saturday 28 Mar shows as 'Yesterday'.
suggested_fix: Compare calendar days with UTC-constructed midnights: `DateTime.utc(now.year, now.month, now.day).difference(DateTime.utc(time.year, time.month, time.day)).inDays`.

title: Notification time label is frozen at ingest, so items never become "Yesterday …"
description: FLOW-18 says only today's items show just the time and older ones name the day. `_formatTime(at)` is evaluated once when the item is ingested (206-213) and stored in `AppNotification.time`; `_formatTime` compares against `_now()` at that moment (248-261). The screen renders `notification.time` (notifications.dart:630) and never recomputes from `at`. The feed is in-memory for the process, so any app/tab left open across midnight shows yesterday's pushes with a bare clock.
failure_scenario: Push at 23:50 shows "23:50"; the next morning the same row still says "23:50" instead of "Yesterday 23:50".
evidence:
notifications_repository.dart:206-213 `final at = (payload.sentAt ?? _now()).toLocal(); _items.insert(0, AppNotification(... time: _formatTime(at), at: at, ...`
notifications.dart:630 `text: notification.time,`
suggested_fix: Format from `notification.at` at build time (or recompute labels on emit).

title: Card brand error 'We accept Visa and Mastercard' is shown untranslated under the card number
description: CardInput.brandError is an English const. add_card_page.dart `_numberError` returns it directly: `if (CardInput.brandRejected(digits)) return CardInput.brandError;` (:125), and the same text is thrown as ArgumentError(CardInput.brandError) (:153) which add_card_page.dart:170 displays via `e.message`. All sibling errors on that page use context.l10n (cardCheckNumber, cardUseMmYy, cardExpired, cardCvc3), so this one field error stays English in fr/sv.
failure_scenario: French rider types a card number starting with 3 (Amex) on Ajouter une carte: the inline error reads 'We accept Visa and Mastercard'.
evidence: saved_cards_controller.dart:67 `static const String brandError = 'We accept Visa and Mastercard';`; add_card_page.dart:125 `if (CardInput.brandRejected(digits)) return CardInput.brandError;`
suggested_fix: Add an ARB key (cardBrandsAccepted) and return context.l10n.cardBrandsAccepted from _numberError; keep the controller's ArgumentError for programmer errors only.

title: Card brand rejection error is a hardcoded English string in a localized form
description: `_numberError` returns `CardInput.brandError` ('We accept Visa and Mastercard', saved_cards_controller.dart:67) while every sibling error on the same field uses `context.l10n.*` (`cardCheckNumber`, `cardUseMmYy`, `cardExpired`, `cardCvc3`). There is no ARB key for this text (no match in app_en/sv/fr.arb), so a Swedish or French rider typing an Amex/Diners number sees an English error under the number field.
failure_scenario: App language Swedish; rider types '3782 8224 6310 005' in Add card → red line 'We accept Visa and Mastercard' among Swedish labels.
evidence: add_card_page.dart:125 `if (CardInput.brandRejected(digits)) return CardInput.brandError;`; add_card_page.dart:127 `if (done && !_numberOk) return context.l10n.cardCheckNumber;`; saved_cards_controller.dart:67 `static const String brandError = 'We accept Visa and Mastercard';`
suggested_fix: Add an ARB key (e.g. `cardBrandUnsupported`) and return `context.l10n.cardBrandUnsupported` from `_numberError`.

title: 'Dropped pin · 59.32930° N 18.06860° E' label is English and becomes the booking address
description: droppedPinPickupAddress builds an English sentence ('Dropped pin · …° N …° E') with no ARB key. SetPickupPage assigns it to `_address` when reverse geocoding yields nothing (:565) and it is shown in the pickup card `Text(_address, ...)` (:1137), then on confirm (:754-756) it is returned as `SetPickupResult.address`, persisted via `_spotsController.remember` and used as the ride's pickup label, so it stays English on Finding/Waiting/History and is sent to the driver. Reproduced under L10n.use('fr'): 'Dropped pin · 59.32930° N 18.06860° E'.
failure_scenario: French rider drags the pin to a spot without a street address and confirms: pickup card, Finding screen, Waiting sheet and History all read 'Dropped pin · 59.32930° N 18.06860° E'.
evidence: pickup_address.dart:35-36 `return 'Dropped pin · ${lat.abs().toStringAsFixed(5)}° $ns '\n      '${lng.abs().toStringAsFixed(5)}° $ew';`; set_pickup_page.dart:565 `_address = droppedPinPickupAddress(at);`; :754-755 `final address = _addressIsStale || needsDroppedPinLabel(_address)\n        ? droppedPinPickupAddress(_center)`
suggested_fix: Add an ARB message with a {coords} placeholder (and localized N/S/E/W) and render it through L10n; store the coordinates, not the sentence, as the booking label.

title: Pickup spot chips and the booked pickup label use hard-coded English ('Main entrance', 'Side entrance', 'Parking', 'Near Home', 'Previously used', 'Short walk')
description: The app ships en/sv/fr ARB files (l10n.yaml, app_sv.arb, app_fr.arb) and none contains these strings. The titles are rendered on the Set pickup chips (set_pickup_page.dart:1217-1222) and, via pickupSpotLabel, become the confirmed pickup address ('Klockarvägen 37 – Main entrance') that is booked and shown to the driver. Only the spot placement is documented as a mock; the labels are production UI. pickup_location.dart:228 likewise shows a literal 'CURRENT' button text.
failure_scenario: Swedish-language rider on Set pickup sees 'Main entrance / Front of the building' chips among otherwise Swedish copy and confirms; the booking's pickup reads 'Klockarvägen 37 – Main entrance'.
evidence:
pickup_spots_controller.dart:75-77 `title: 'Main entrance', subtitle: 'Front of the building',`
pickup_spots_controller.dart:117-118 `title: 'Previously used', subtitle: spotName ?? pickupSpotStreet(p.address),`
pickup_location.dart:228 `text: 'CURRENT',`
suggested_fix: Move the titles/subtitles to the ARB files (L10n.current.*) and localize the 'CURRENT' label.

title: Confirm pickup spot shows the raw English 'Current location' / 'Pickup location' in its field and address line
description: ConfirmPickupSpot writes the English constants straight into the search TextField and the address Text instead of going through L10n.place: initState copies `widget.initialAddress` into `_address` and `_search.text` (:134, :143), and Home passes `'Current location'` there (home.dart:752 `cleanAddress = gps != null ? 'Current location' : ...` and :760 `(_pickupAddress ?? 'Current location')`). Inside the page `_address = 'Current location'; _search.text = _address;` (:170-171, :271-272) and `pickupLocationFallbackLabel` ('Pickup location', :228) are assigned the same way. They are rendered with `TextField(controller: _search, ...)` at :459 and `Text(_address, ...)` at :515 with no translation. L10n.place (l10n.dart:92-96) is only applied by shortenPlace/compactAddress on other screens, never here. The page is on the Book-now path (home.dart:756 ConfirmPickupSpot.open) and on route change (route_change_flow.dart:74).
failure_scenario: French rider on Home with location on taps the pickup field → 'Confirmer le point de départ' page opens with the search box and the grey address line reading 'Current location'; moving the pin where no street resolves shows 'Pickup location'.
evidence: confirm_pickup_spot.dart:170-171 `_address = 'Current location';\n      _search.text = _address;`; :228 `? pickupLocationFallbackLabel`; :459 `controller: _search,`; :515 `_address,`; home.dart:752 `cleanAddress = gps != null ? 'Current location' : locationOffPickupLabel;`
suggested_fix: Keep the English sentinel internally but render `L10n.place(_address)` / `L10n.current.pickupLocation` in the TextField and Text, and extend L10n.place to cover pickupLocationFallbackLabel.

title: `_idle` turns a superseded (null) reverse-geocode into the 'Pickup location' fallback and can overwrite the newer resolved address
description: Every `onCameraIdle` (line 345-349) calls `_idle()`, which awaits `_pickup.reverse(_center)`. `PickupMapController.reverse` (pickup_controller.dart:53-74) deliberately returns `null` for a call that was superseded by a newer one (`if (!_stale.isCurrent(generation)) return null;`). `_idle` does not distinguish 'superseded' from 'no address': `isUnusablePickupLabel(null)` is true, so it does `setState(() { _address = pickupLocationFallbackLabel; _search.text = label; })`. The two lookups are independent HTTP requests (AppGeocoding dedupes only identical keys), so when the newer request B completes before the older request A, B's continuation writes the real street and A's continuation then overwrites it with 'Pickup location'. `_confirmPosition` (line 296-305) books `confirmedPickupAddress(_address, position)`, which keeps that fallback string. Contrast set_pickup_page.dart:550-570 `_resolveAddressNow`, which guards with its own `_resolveGeneration` and `_isAwayFrom(at, _center)` before applying.
failure_scenario: Rider drags the pin, lets go (request A starts), nudges it once more and lets go (request B starts). B answers first and shows 'Klockarvägen 37'; A then answers (as null, superseded) and the card flips to 'Pickup location'. The rider confirms and the booking/driver gets the neutral label 'Pickup location' although the street had been resolved.
evidence: confirm_pickup_spot.dart:222-233 `Future<void> _idle() async { if (_moving) return; final address = await _pickup.reverse(_center); if (!mounted) return; final label = isUnusablePickupLabel(address) ? pickupLocationFallbackLabel : address!.trim(); setState(() { _address = label; _search.text = label; }); }` | pickup_controller.dart:61 `if (!_stale.isCurrent(generation)) return null;` | pickup_address.dart:18-23 `bool isUnusablePickupLabel(String? label) { final clean = label?.trim() ?? ''; return clean.isEmpty || ...` | confirm_pickup_spot.dart:300 `final address = confirmedPickupAddress(_address, position);`
suggested_fix: Give `_idle` its own generation counter (or read `_pickup`'s) and return without touching state when the lookup was superseded or when `_isAwayFrom(at)`; only apply the fallback label when the current lookup genuinely returned no address.

title: Address search result lands with no staleness guard and yanks the pin after the rider moved on
description: _searchAddress closes the sheet, then `final found = await _pickup.search(text)` (PickupMapController.search -> geocoding.geocodeAddress, up to the 8 s API timeout, no generation/stale check and no try/catch) and unconditionally calls `_glideTo(found.position, address: ...)`, which rewrites _center/_routeStart/_address and animates the camera. While the search is pending the page is fully interactive (no busy state), so a drag, a spot chip or My location can already have moved the pin; the old search then overrides it. ConfirmPickupSpot._lookup (confirm_pickup_spot.dart:286-293) has the same shape. The page's own reverse lookups and requotes are generation-guarded (RIDE-12), only the forward search is not. A thrown search (offline) is also uncaught here, so the snackbar 'addressNotFoundMoveMap' never appears.
failure_scenario: Rider types 'Storgatan 1' and submits, then immediately drags the pin to the exact entrance; 3-8 s later the geocode answers and the pin jumps back to Storgatan 1 with that label, the quote re-runs, and the rider confirms a pickup they did not choose.
evidence:
set_pickup_page.dart:700-710 `final text = query?.trim() ?? ''; if (text.isEmpty || !mounted) return; final found = await _pickup.search(text); if (!mounted) return; if (found == null) { ...snackbar...; return; } await _glideTo(found.position, address: found.address ?? text);`
pickup_controller.dart:113-120 `Future<PickupMapFix?> search(String query) async { final result = await geocoding.geocodeAddress(query); ...` (no stale guard, no catch)
suggested_fix: Bump a generation (or compare _center/_routeStart before and after) around the search and ignore a result once the pin has moved or a newer search started; wrap in try/catch and show the not-found snackbar on failure.

title: Account security error messages are English literals shown on the Security screen
description: The controller stores `errorMessage = 'Account security is unavailable right now.'` (:42) and `'Could not update active sessions.'` (:67). security.dart renders them to the rider: `body: _security.errorMessage ?? context.l10n.securityUnavailableBody` (:72) and `Text(_security.errorMessage!, ...)` (:238). Because errorMessage is non-null whenever load() fails, the localized securityUnavailableBody is never used in the failure case, so fr/sv riders always see English.
failure_scenario: Server returns 500 for the security endpoint; French rider opens Account → Sécurité and reads 'Account security is unavailable right now.' under the tile; tapping 'Sign out other devices' after a failure shows 'Could not update active sessions.'
evidence: account_security_controller.dart:42 `errorMessage = 'Account security is unavailable right now.';`; :67 `errorMessage = 'Could not update active sessions.';`; security.dart:72 `body: _security.errorMessage ??` ; :238 `_security.errorMessage!,`
suggested_fix: Set errorMessage from L10n.current (reuse securityUnavailableBody and add a key for the sign-out failure).

title: Pending profile sync is forgotten on restart although the code promises a resend on launch
description: `_syncPending` is a plain in-memory field (301). `save()` keeps the local copy and swallows the PATCH failure, setting `_syncPending = true` (341-352); `hydrate()` only resends `if (_syncPending)` (313-316). After the app is killed the flag is false again, so a name/consent change that never reached the server is not resent on the next launch, contrary to the class comment ("sent again with the next save or launch"). The driver app shows the rider's name from this profile.
failure_scenario: Rider renames themselves while offline, closes the app; next launch the server still has the old name until the rider edits the profile again.
evidence:
synced_profile_repository.dart:301 `bool _syncPending = false;`
synced_profile_repository.dart:313-316 `Future<void> hydrate() async { await _cache.hydrate(); if (_syncPending) await _sync(_cache.current); }`
synced_profile_repository.dart:349-351 `} catch (error) { _syncPending = true; ...`
suggested_fix: Persist the pending flag (e.g. a `movera_profile_sync_pending` pref) and read it in `hydrate`, or compare a stored "last synced" hash with the cache.

title: Promotion details opened from Pay with / the Home ticket list the 14 built-in categories, not the live catalog
description: `PromotionDetailsSheet.open` defaults `categories` to `AppScope.instance.rideCatalog.rides()`. In di.dart:337 `rideCatalog` is `RideSelectionRepository()`, whose `builtInRides` is the 14-item fallback list that explicitly includes seven 'Categories the admin may switch on later' (van, wheelchair, business, airport, kids, women, delivery; ride_selection_repository.dart:84-162). The live catalog is `AppScope.instance.catalog.current` (di.dart:341, RideCatalogController), which SelectRide uses for its own `_openPromotionDetails`. PayWithPage (pay_with_page.dart:271 `PromotionDetailsSheet.open(context, promo)`) and the default `onTap` of PromotionTicket (promotion_ticket.dart:54) use the default, so the 'Prices with promotion' section lists categories the rider cannot book and, when `rideTypes` is empty, marks each 'Included'.
failure_scenario: Server catalog has the 7 seed categories. Rider opens Pay with → taps the promotion row → sheet lists Van, Wheelchair, Business, Airport, Kids seat, Women driver and Delivery as 'Included', none of which exist on Select Ride.
evidence: promotion_details_sheet.dart:74-79 `final list = categories ?? [ for (final ride in AppScope.instance.rideCatalog.rides()) PromotionCategory(id: ride.id, name: ride.name), ];`; di.dart:337 `late final RideSelectionRepository rideCatalog = RideSelectionRepository();` vs di.dart:341 `late final RideCatalogController catalog = RideCatalogController(api: api);`; ride_selection_repository.dart:84-85 `// Categories the admin may switch on later; the pictures ship with the // app, the admin decides what is shown.`
suggested_fix: Default to `AppScope.instance.catalog.current` (the server/cached catalog) instead of `rideCatalog.rides()`.

title: update() coalesces different patches on the same reservation and silently drops the second
description: `update` returns the in-flight future for any concurrent call with the same reservationId regardless of patch content (186-195). The callers are the rider's edit confirm (scheduled_ride_booking.dart:62-78) and the simulated trip step writer `_driveMockTrip` (401-410), which calls `update(id, ReservationPatch(status: to))` and returns `true` even if its patch was dropped. `canEdit` is true for `driverEnRoute`/`driverArrived` (reservation_status.dart:34), so in demo builds an edit confirmed while a trip step is in flight either loses the status step (trip then stalls: next step finds `current.status != from` and returns false) or loses the edit.
failure_scenario: Demo build: driver en route, rider confirms an edit at the moment the simulated "arrived" step writes; one of the two writes is dropped without error — either the simulated trip never progresses or the edit vanishes though Review changes said it was applied.
evidence:
reservation_controller.dart:186-195 `final pending = _pendingUpdateByReservationId[reservationId]; if (pending != null) return pending;`
reservation_controller.dart:408-409 `await update(id, ReservationPatch(status: to)); return true;`
suggested_fix: Key the in-flight map by (reservationId, patch identity) or queue updates through the repository's `_oneAtATime` instead of coalescing distinct patches.

title: Zone wall-clock pickup time is stored as a device-local DateTime and compared with DateTime.now()
description: Q9 makes every Book-later time the pickup zone's wall-clock time: `ZoneClock.wallTime` returns a plain local `DateTime(local.year, …)` (zone_clock.dart:57-69) and `PickupSchedule` works in those (stockholm_schedule.dart:105-121). The picker returns that wall-clock value (select_date_time.dart:131, 153-158) and it flows unchanged into `ReservationDraft.scheduledPickupAt` (scheduled_ride_checkout.dart:21-32). The backend path converts it to a UTC instant (`PickupSchedule(timezone).toUtc(at)`, scheduled_rides_controller.dart:63-64), but the local reservation path never does: `startLiveIfDue` computes `ride.scheduledPickupAt.difference(currentTime)` with `currentTime = DateTime.now()` (334, 329), the chrono counts down with `DateTime.now()` (home_reservation_chrono.dart:206, 242-249; reservation_format.dart:99,117), `isNoDriverFound` (313-316) and the cancel-fee window (scheduled_ride_rules.dart:93-103) do the same. Whenever the device time zone differs from the pickup zone's (any browser outside CET on the public web build; a Stockholm phone booking a Tunis pickup in summer; a traveller abroad), every one of these is off by the offset. Throwaway test in this UTC container: minimumPickup() for 10:00Z gives wall-clock 12:30 (local, isUtc=false); `pickup.difference(now)` = 2:30:00 and the chrono label reads `2h 30m` for a ride 30 minutes away.
failure_scenario: Web rider with browser in UTC (or a Stockholm phone in Tunis zone in summer) books a Stockholm pickup for 12:30 local (30 min ahead). Home chrono shows 2 h 30 m; `startLiveIfDue` reaches T-2 two hours after the real pickup; "No driver found" fires two hours late; free-cancel window shown/charged against the wrong instant.
evidence:
zone_clock.dart:57-69 `static DateTime wallTime(...) { ... return DateTime(local.year, local.month, local.day, local.hour, ...); }`
select_date_time.dart:131 `Navigator.pop(context, _selectedDateTime);`
scheduled_ride_checkout.dart:31 `scheduledPickupAt: when,`
reservation_controller.dart:329-334 `final currentTime = now ?? _clock(); ... final untilPickup = ride.scheduledPickupAt.difference(currentTime);`
home_reservation_chrono.dart:206 `DateTime get _now => widget.now?.call() ?? DateTime.now();`
scheduled_rides_controller.dart:63-64 `scheduledAt: switch (scheduledAt) { final at? => WireTime.format(PickupSchedule(timezone).toUtc(at)), ... }`
suggested_fix: Convert the picked wall-clock time to an instant (`PickupSchedule(timeZone).toUtc(when)`) before building the ReservationDraft, and render it back with `ZoneClock.wallTime` in the reservation screens; or store the IANA zone with the reservation and use it in every comparison.

title: cardDate 'Tomorrow' label breaks on the spring-forward day because today.add(Duration(days:1)) is not the next local midnight
description: cardDate compares `day == today.add(const Duration(days: 1))` where today is a local midnight. Dart's add() works in absolute time, so on the DST switch day the result is 01:00 of the next day, not midnight (verified by throwaway test: DateTime(2026,3,29).add(Duration(days:1)) == 2026-03-30 01:00:00 under Europe/Stockholm). The equality then fails and the reservation card falls through to weekdayDate instead of 'Tomorrow, 30 Mar'.
failure_scenario: On Sunday 29 Mar 2026 a Stockholm rider with a reservation on Monday 30 Mar sees 'Mon, 30 Mar' on the upcoming card instead of 'Tomorrow 30 Mar'. Same for Tunisia or any zone with DST on its switch day.
suggested_fix: Build tomorrow as `DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day + 1)` (calendar arithmetic) instead of adding a Duration.

title: Cancelling a scheduled ride from the live screen records no late-cancel fee
description: The Upcoming page computes the terms and passes the agreed fee: `cancelTermsFor(ride)` then `_reservations.cancel(id, reason:, fee: terms.fee)` (upcoming_reservation.dart:131-142). The two other cancel entry points for the same reservation never pass a fee: `ReservationLiveRide.onCancel` calls `reservations.cancel(ride.reservationId, reason: reasonId ?? 'rider_cancelled_live')` (78-85) and `ReservationRideRealtime.cancelRide` does the same (reservation_ride_realtime.dart:255-265). The live screen is exactly where the rider is once the driver is en route (T-2 min, `startLiveIfDue` 383-394 + chrono `_openLiveIfNeeded`), i.e. inside the late-cancel window the rules define (scheduled_ride_rules.dart:86-118, default 60 min / 50 kr). The cancelled ride is then saved with `cancellationFee == null`, History shows plain "Cancelled" (reservation_format.dart:27-33) and no fee is recorded, while the same cancel five minutes earlier from the Upcoming page records 50 kr.
failure_scenario: Rules: free until 60 min before pickup, 50 kr after. Rider lets the driver start (T-2), the live screen opens, taps Cancel: the ride is cancelled with no fee recorded; History and the receipt show no fee, contradicting the terms the rider was shown.
evidence:
reservation_live_ride.dart:78-82 `onCancel: (context, reasonId) async { await reservations.cancel(ride.reservationId, reason: reasonId ?? 'rider_cancelled_live'); ...`
reservation_ride_realtime.dart:259-263 `unawaited(controller.cancel(reservationId, reason: 'rider_cancelled_live'));`
upcoming_reservation.dart:131-142 `final terms = _reservations.cancelTermsFor(ride); ... await _reservations.cancel(ride.reservationId, reason: outcome.reasonId, fee: terms.fee);`
suggested_fix: Compute `reservations.cancelTermsFor(ride)` in both live-screen cancel paths and pass `fee: terms.fee` (and show the terms note in the live cancel sheet).

title: Editing a reservation duplicates its preferences note and cannot remove them
description: When editing, `ScheduleRide.initState` copies the stored note into the session (`_session.captureNote(editing.note!.trim())`, schedule_ride.dart:88) and `openScheduledCategorySelector` passes it to `SelectRide(note: …)` (449). SelectRide treats `widget.note` as the rider's free-text extra and prepends it to the freshly selected chips: `note: _driverNote(widget.note)` with `_driverNote` = `[extra, ..._notes.selected].join(' · ')` (select_ride.dart:1170, 1204-1210), while `_notes` starts at `RideNotes.empty` (select_ride.dart:285) so the stored chips are not pre-selected. Result: the stored note (e.g. `Bags`) is always re-sent; choosing bags again yields `Bags · Bags`; de-selecting cannot remove anything. On top, `ScheduledRideBooking.confirm` sends `note: note` and the patch cannot clear a note because `Reservation.copyWith` does `note: note ?? this.note` (reservation.dart:353, local_reservation_repository.dart:207).
failure_scenario: Rider edits a scheduled ride that had "Bags", chooses 1-2 bags again on Set pickup and confirms: the ride now shows preferences "Bags · Bags". A rider who no longer has a pet cannot get "Pet" off the ride through Edit.
evidence:
schedule_ride.dart:88 `if (editing.hasPreferences) _session.captureNote(editing.note!.trim());`
scheduled_category_gate.dart:449 `note: session.note.trim().isEmpty ? null : session.note.trim(),`
select_ride.dart:1170 `note: _driverNote(widget.note),`
select_ride.dart:1204-1210 `final parts = <String>[ if (extra != null && extra.trim().isNotEmpty) extra.trim(), ..._notes.selected ]; if (parts.isEmpty) return extra; return parts.join(' · ');`
reservation.dart:353 `note: note ?? this.note,`
suggested_fix: When editing, parse the stored note into `RideNotes` (chips) and keep only the free-text remainder as `extra`; add a `clearNote` flag to `ReservationPatch`/`copyWith` so an empty selection removes the note.

title: A stale suppressRestore from a previous ride wipes a server-adopted snapshot in resumeIfNeeded (push-open of a ride booked on another device)
description: `RideSession.suppressRestore` is set true by every terminal `localTransition`/`backendReconcile` (ride_session.dart 82, 148) and is only reset by a non-terminal transition or `reset()` (sign-out wipe). After the rider closes or cancels a ride on this device the flag stays true indefinitely. `openRideFromNotification` → `_openRide` (notification_navigation.dart 88-125) reads no snapshot, calls `adoptServerActiveTrip(expectedRideId)` which saves the server trip as the snapshot (ride_restore_coordinator.dart 78-100), then calls `resumeIfNeeded()`. `resumeIfNeeded` reads the new snapshot, resyncs, and then hits `if (AppScope.instance.ride.suppressRestore) { unawaited(RideSnapshotStore.clear()); return null; }` (595-598): the just-adopted trip is deleted and nothing opens, although the flag belongs to a different, finished ride. The cold-start path (`_root` → `pageFor`) has no such check, so the same trip is restored after a restart.
failure_scenario: Release build (ApiActiveTripRepository): rider finishes ride A on their phone (Done → closed). Later they book ride B on the web; the push for B taps on the phone. `_openRide` adopts B from the server, then `resumeIfNeeded` clears it and returns; the rider sees Home with no ride, and 'This ride has ended.' may be shown by `openNotificationRide`.
evidence: ride_session.dart:82 `suppressRestore = status.isTerminal;` and 148 `suppressRestore = backendStatus.isTerminal;` ; ride_restore_coordinator.dart:595-598 `if (AppScope.instance.ride.suppressRestore) { unawaited(RideSnapshotStore.clear()); return null; }` ; notification_navigation.dart:93-96 `await RideSnapshotStore.read() ?? await RideRestoreCoordinator.instance.adoptServerActiveTrip(expectedRideId: expected)` then 123 `await RideRestoreCoordinator.instance.resumeIfNeeded();`
suggested_fix: Scope `suppressRestore` to the ride id it was set for (ignore it when the snapshot's rideId differs from `session.rideId`), or clear it in `adoptServerActiveTrip`.

title: Screen-reader labels 'Restoring active ride' and 'plate …' are English in every language
description: Two Semantics labels bypass l10n: the ride-recovery barrier `Semantics(label: 'Restoring active ride', ...)` (:620) read aloud while a live ride is restored on cold start, and upcoming_reservation.dart:506 `'plate ${driver.plate}'` inside the driver card's Semantics label list. TalkBack/VoiceOver users on fr/sv hear English.
failure_scenario: Swedish VoiceOver user reloads during a live ride: the barrier announces 'Restoring active ride'; on the upcoming reservation the driver card announces 'plate ABC123'.
evidence: ride_restore_coordinator.dart:619-620 `child: Semantics(\n          label: 'Restoring active ride',`; upcoming_reservation.dart:506 `if (driver.plate != null) 'plate ${driver.plate}',`
suggested_fix: Use L10n.current (e.g. rtConnectingBody or a new key) for both labels.

title: restoreFromBackend/backendReconcile never logs the `ride.restore.jump` record that DECISIONS R6 specifies for illegal jumps
description: docs/DECISIONS.md line 67 (R6) states that `restoreFromBackend` 'may jump; illegal jumps log `ride.restore.jump` and are not rejected'. `backendReconcile` (98-152) logs only `ride.restore.stale` when ordering rejects an event and otherwise assigns the status silently; `canTransition` is never consulted and the string `ride.restore.jump` does not exist anywhere in the repository (grep). Operators relying on that log to detect backend projections that skip states get nothing.
failure_scenario: Backend projection moves a session from `driverArriving` straight to `paymentFinalized` (the example in the code comment at 141-142). Per R6 a `ride.restore.jump` entry should be logged for diagnostics; no log line is emitted.
evidence: docs/DECISIONS.md:67 'illegal jumps log `ride.restore.jump` and are not rejected' ; ride_session.dart:140-152 `// Deliberately do not apply the local transition graph here ... rideId = id ?? rideId; status = backendStatus;` with no AppLog call on that path
suggested_fix: In `backendReconcile`, when `!canTransition(status, backendStatus)` log `AppLog.info('ride.restore.jump', ...)` before assigning.

title: Ride-completed driver card falls back to English 'Vehicle details unavailable'
description: DriverRepository.current() builds DriverProfile with `vehicle: vehicle.isEmpty ? 'Vehicle details unavailable' : vehicle` (:55) (and tagline 'Movera driver' / '{n} trips completed', :52-54). RideCompletedDriverInfo (driver_info.dart:70 `text: driver.vehicle`) renders the vehicle line to the rider on the Ride completed screen (ride_completed.dart:387). When the matched driver carried no make/model/color the English fallback is shown in fr/sv; no ARB key exists for it.
failure_scenario: A ride completes with a driver payload lacking vehicleMake/Model/Color; the Swedish Ride completed → driver info panel shows 'Vehicle details unavailable'.
evidence:
driver_repository.dart:52-55 `tagline: driver.tripCount == null
          ? 'Movera driver'
          : '${driver.tripCount} trips completed',
      vehicle: vehicle.isEmpty ? 'Vehicle details unavailable' : vehicle,`; driver_info.dart:70 `text: driver.vehicle,`
suggested_fix: Use L10n.current for the vehicle fallback (and the tagline, which also has no localized form).

title: Trip/booking parsers read the in-process mock envelope (destination, ride.id, flat vehicleMake) rather than the documented TripProjection (dropoff, tripId, driver.vehicle{...})
description: contracts/CONTRACT.md §2 and openapi.yaml define TripProjection{tripId, pickup: Place, dropoff: Place, fare: Money, driver?: DriverSummary{driverId, firstName, vehicle:{make,model,color,plate}}} and say success responses are the bare resource. RideProjection._place(ride,'destination') (lines 80-101) only looks at `ride['destination']` / `ride['destinationLat']`, never `dropoff`; MatchedDriver.fromJson (lib/core/contracts/matched_driver.dart:78-83) requires `json['id']` and reads flat `vehicleMake`/`vehicleModel`/`plate`, so a DriverSummary with `driverId` + nested `vehicle` yields null (driver card empty, plate missing); BookingCoordinator._requireRideId (lib/features/booking/application/booking_coordinator.dart:92-106) throws FormatException unless the response is `{ride:{id}}`. ApiRideRealtime does accept both shapes via tripProjectionOf, which shows the contract shape is expected elsewhere, so the booking/history/restore paths are inconsistent with it. Confidence is moderate because the docs also call InProcessMockClient the 'v1 mock contract'; if the production server really emits the mock envelope this is intended.
failure_scenario: Against a server that follows contracts/openapi.yaml: POST /trips returns {tripId,...} -> _requireRideId throws 'Booking response missing ride object' and the rider sees a booking error; GET /trips history returns dropoff -> destination is null -> toSnapshot returns null -> rides disappear; driver {driverId, vehicle:{plate}} -> MatchedDriver null -> no driver/plate shown during the trip.
suggested_fix: Accept the contract shape as the primary form: read `dropoff` (fallback `destination`), `tripId` (fallback ride.id), `driverId` and nested `vehicle{make,model,color,plate}`; or update CONTRACT.md/openapi to the envelope the app actually parses. Also wrap the `as String?` casts in MatchedDriver.fromJson (a numeric id throws TypeError, which RideProjection.toSnapshot does not catch).

title: Any failure in closeCompletedRide traps the rider on the completion screen with a misleading 'feedback could not be saved' error
description: `_leave` wraps feedback submission and `closeCompletedRide` in one try/catch; any throw from the latter sets `_submitError = context.l10n.feedbackSaveFailed` and `_leaving = false` (259-265), and both Done and Back route through `_leave`, so the rider can never leave. `closeCompletedRide` can throw after the feedback was accepted: `localTransition(RideStatus.closed)` (active_ride_controller.dart 459) throws `InvalidRideTransition` when the session is already terminal, which happens when a `paymentFailed` (or other terminal) projection is reconciled by the still-live `DriverTrackingController` during the Waiting→RideCompleted `pushReplacement` handoff (RideCompleted's own listener ignores non-completed statuses, 123-127, so the screen keeps showing 'Trip complete'); `archive` can also throw its `StateError` after six lost writes (on_demand_ride_history_store.dart 172-176). The message then blames the rating/tip, which was in fact sent (`_acceptedFeedbackIntent` is set).
failure_scenario: Payment fails on the server right as Waiting hands over to the summary. The rider rates the driver and taps Done: the rating is sent, then 'Your feedback could not be saved' appears every time, and neither Done nor Back leaves the screen.
evidence: ride_completed.dart:252-265 `await _controller.closeCompletedRide(widget.rideId!); ... } catch (_) { ... _leaving = false; _submitError = context.l10n.feedbackSaveFailed;` ; active_ride_controller.dart:459 `AppScope.instance.ride.localTransition(RideStatus.closed);` ; ride_transition.dart:141-145 `if (from.isTerminal) return false;`
suggested_fix: Separate the two failure classes: keep the error only for a refused feedback submission, and make leaving tolerant (catch `InvalidRideTransition`/archive errors, clear the snapshot and still navigate Home).

title: A server quote in another currency clears prices but not the old-currency quotes, so discounts and promo prices mix currencies
description: The `currency` setter (65-69) only does `offeredPrices.clear()`; `authoritativeQuotes`, `quoteExpiresAt` and `quoteIds` keep the quotes priced in the previous currency. `adoptQuote` (457) switches the currency whenever the server prices in another zone's currency (documented as allowed: 'a quote the server prices in another currency moves it'). After that, for every other category `_discountFor` (select_ride.dart:2172-2176) still returns the old-currency discount, so the tile shows a strikethrough `_kr(price + discount)` (2320-2331) that adds the SEK catalog list price to a SEK discount and formats the sum in the new currency, while the main price correctly shows '…'. `_promotionPrices` (2140-2155) likewise hands the old-currency quote amounts to the promotion sheet under `currency: _selection.currency` (2167).
failure_scenario: Pickup geocoded in Sweden, server answers the first quote in EUR: the other tiles show '…' as price but a struck-through '259 €' discount line, and the promotion sheet lists SEK amounts labelled €.
evidence: ride_selection_controller.dart:65-69 `set currency(String value) { if (value == _currency) return; _currency = value; offeredPrices.clear(); }`; ride_selection_controller.dart:457 `currency = quote.currency;`; select_ride.dart:2172-2176 `final quote = _selection.authoritativeQuotes[ride.id]; if (quote == null || quote.discountMinor <= 0) return 0; return Money(quote.discountMinor, quote.currency).major;`; select_ride.dart:2320-2324 `if (discount > 0) _fitPrice(context, Text(_kr(price + discount),`
suggested_fix: Clear `authoritativeQuotes`, `quoteIds`, `quoteExpiresAt` (and add the ids to `unavailableQuoteIds`) in the currency setter, and have `_discountFor`/`_promotionPrices` skip quotes whose `currency != _selection.currency`.

title: Wallet is offered as the full payment method for fares above the balance; completion then drives the ledger negative
description: The wallet row is listed whenever `walletBalance > 0` with no comparison against the fare (ride_selection_controller.dart:265-268), PayWithPage pops `'wallet'` on tap with no check (pay_with_page.dart:224-232), and `walletSplitFor` returns `WalletSplit.none` for the wallet method (200-202) so `walletAmountMinor` is 0 and the server-side range check in the mock (`walletMinor > serverTotal`) cannot catch it. At completion `RideCompleted._maybeChargeWallet` → `chargeCompletedRideById` → `chargeCompletedRide` charges `amount = snapshot.price` (wallet_controller.dart:282-283) and `LocalWalletRepository._apply` subtracts with no floor (wallet_repository.dart:215-218), so the stored balance becomes negative and WalletHome shows e.g. '-209 kr'. Reproduced: `brand=wallet walletMinor=0 remainderMinor=25900` and `balance after wallet-paid 259 kr ride from 50 kr: -209.0`.
failure_scenario: Rider has 50 kr in the wallet, picks a 259 kr ride, opens Pay with, taps the Movera Wallet row ('Balance: 50 kr'), books. Ride completes: wallet balance shows -209 kr, the wallet disappears from Pay with (balance not > 0), and the next 100 kr top-up shows -109 kr.
evidence: ride_selection_controller.dart:265-268 `if (item.brand == 'wallet') { return _flags.enableWallet && walletBalance > 0 && walletMatchesTrip; }`; pay_with_page.dart:226-232 `_row(... title: context.l10n.walletBalance(...), onTap: () => Navigator.of(context).pop('wallet'),)`; wallet_controller.dart:282-283 `if (paidByWallet) { amount = snapshot.price;`; wallet_repository.dart:215-218 `final nextMinor = Money.fromLegacyMajor(current, currency).amountMinor + Money.fromLegacyMajor(deltaKr, currency).amountMinor; final next = Money(nextMinor, currency).major; await _source.saveBalance(next);`
suggested_fix: Offer the wallet as a full method only when `walletBalance >= fare` of the selected ride (or show it disabled with 'Balance too low'), and clamp `debitRide` to the available balance / refuse the charge with a logged error.

title: Saved 'wallet' default payment is silently replaced by Cash on every Select Ride open (load-order race)
description: `SelectRide.initState` starts `_loadSavedCards(paymentName)` (line 353) and `_loadWalletBalance()` (line 361) concurrently. `_loadSavedCards` → `restoreDefaultPayment()` reads the saved brand and, because `payments()` only lists the wallet when `walletBalance > 0` (ride_selection_controller.dart:267) and the balance has not loaded yet, hits `if (saved == null || !list.any((item) => item.brand == saved)) { _selectDefaultPayment(); }` and selects Cash. `_loadWalletBalance` resolves later (`loadUseWalletFirst` → `WalletStore.loadPayments` performs four `prefs.remove` platform calls plus possible writes before returning) and calls `setWalletBalance`, which only re-selects the *current* brand (`if (current != null) selectPaymentByBrand(current);`, 598-602), i.e. Cash. The remembered wallet default (persisted by `selectPayment` → `_persistSelectedBrand` and by WalletScreen `_selectMethod('wallet')`) is therefore never restored, contradicting the R10 note in default_payment_store.dart ('the choice survives relaunch'). A return ride whose origin was paid with 'Movera Wallet' loses it the same way (`selectPaymentNamed` runs before the balance is known). Reproduced with a throwaway test driving the same sequence on the controller: `afterRestore=cash walletOffered=true afterBalance=cash savedDefault=wallet`.
failure_scenario: Rider with 500 kr in the wallet chooses Movera Wallet in Pay with (persisted as default). Next time they open Select Ride the footer shows Cash; if they do not notice, the ride is booked as Cash and the driver asks for cash.
evidence: ride_selection_controller.dart:572-582 `final saved = store == null ? null : await store.read(); final list = payments(); if (saved == null || !list.any((item) => item.brand == saved)) { _selectDefaultPayment(); }`; ride_selection_controller.dart:265-268 `if (item.brand == 'wallet') { return _flags.enableWallet && walletBalance > 0 && walletMatchesTrip; }`; ride_selection_controller.dart:598-602 `void setWalletBalance(double balance) { final current = selectedPaymentItem()?.brand; walletBalance = balance; if (current != null) selectPaymentByBrand(current); }`; select_ride.dart:353 `unawaited(_loadSavedCards(paymentName));` and :361 `unawaited(_loadWalletBalance());`. Throwaway test output: `afterRestore=cash walletOffered=true afterBalance=cash savedDefault=wallet`.
suggested_fix: Remember the saved brand in the controller (e.g. `_pendingDefaultBrand`) when it is not yet offered, and re-apply it in `setWalletBalance`/`setZonePaymentMethods` once it appears; or have SelectRide await the wallet balance before `restoreDefaultPayment`.

title: Scheduled reservation estimatedDropoffAt is pickup time + driver ETA, not pickup + trip duration
description: `confirm` computes `final dropoff = when.add(Duration(minutes: ride.etaMin));` and `ScheduledRideCheckout.draftFrom` does the same (scheduled_ride_checkout.dart:32). `etaMin` is the driver's minutes to the pickup (ride_selection.dart 'arrival'/'etaMin', 6-15 min), while the screen the rider just confirmed shows 'Arrive HH:MM' as `scheduled.add(Duration(minutes: _tripMinutes()))` (select_ride.dart:836-840) and Set pickup likewise uses `tripMinutes`. The stored `estimatedDropoffAt` is therefore a few minutes after pickup for every scheduled ride, is written to the reservation JSON (`reservation.dart:370-371`) and the local repository, and disagrees with the time shown at booking. No rider screen reads it today (`ReservationFormat.dropoffAt` has no callers), which keeps this low.
failure_scenario: Rider schedules a 25-minute trip for 07:00; Select Ride shows 'Pickup 07:00 · Arrive 07:25'; the reservation persists estimatedDropoffAt = 07:08 (etaMin 8).
evidence: scheduled_ride_booking.dart:53 `final dropoff = when.add(Duration(minutes: ride.etaMin));`; scheduled_ride_checkout.dart:32 `estimatedDropoffAt: when.add(Duration(minutes: ride.etaMin)),`; select_ride.dart:838-840 `if (scheduled != null) { return clockTime(scheduled.add(Duration(minutes: _tripMinutes()))); }`
suggested_fix: Pass the trip minutes (the same `estimatedTripMinutes` SelectRide shows) into `confirm`/`draftFrom` and use `when.add(Duration(minutes: tripMinutes))`.

title: Ride category descriptions and badges ('RECOMMENDED', 'FASTER', 'Affordable and convenient rides') have no translation path
description: RideCatalogItem.note/badge are rendered raw on Select ride (select_ride.dart:2355 `ride.note,` and :2376 `ride.badge!,`). The built-in list (the initial `_current` of RideCatalogController and the offline/cold-start fallback, ride_catalog_controller.dart:27, :89) and the in-process mock catalog (in_process_mock_client.dart:176-204) both carry English-only notes/badges; unlike payment rows (payment_labels.dart maps the English detail strings to ARB keys) there is no mapping for catalog text and no ARB keys for them. The API client also sends no Accept-Language/language header (api_client.dart:80-82 only Accept/Content-Type), so a real server has no way to localize them either. In the public demo build (mock client) every fr/sv rider therefore sees English descriptions and badges on the main booking screen.
failure_scenario: Swedish rider opens Välj din resa: each category row shows 'Affordable and convenient rides', 'Newer cars with extra legroom' and the badges 'RECOMMENDED'/'FASTER' in English.
evidence: ride_selection_repository.dart:14 `note: 'Affordable and convenient rides',`; :19 `badge: 'RECOMMENDED',`; :50 `badge: 'FASTER',`; select_ride.dart:2355 `ride.note,`; :2376 `ride.badge!,`; api_client.dart:80-82 `final headers = <String, String>{ 'Accept': 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json',`
suggested_fix: Map built-in/mock notes and badges by category id to ARB keys at display time (as payment_labels.dart does), and send Accept-Language with L10n.code so the server can localize catalog text.

title: Scheduled booking does not refresh a quote that expired during the date picker and Set pickup; the rider is told there is no price and must retry
description: `_book` checks `quoteIsAvailable` once, then `_bookScheduled` opens the date-time picker and Set pickup (and possibly the picker again for return rides) before `ScheduledRideCheckout.run` → `draftFrom` → `ScheduledRideBooking.quotedPrice`, which throws `ScheduledQuoteRequiredException` as soon as `authoritativePriceFor` is null. Quotes expire after 2 minutes (in_process_mock_client.dart:2173 and catalog_quote_repository.dart:35), so a rider who spends more than two minutes choosing a time and pickup spot gets the `resErrNoPriceBook` toast and nothing is booked; Book now handles the same situation by re-quoting in place (`_quoteAfterPickup`, RIDE-2) but the scheduled path has no equivalent. Tapping Book again then shows 'price unavailable, refreshing' and the rider must repeat the picker and pickup steps.
failure_scenario: Rider taps Schedule, spends 3 minutes picking Saturday 07:00 and adjusting the pickup pin, taps 'Confirm and schedule' → toast that no price is available; reservation not created; second attempt repeats every step.
evidence: select_ride.dart:1110-1116 `if (_selection.scheduledFor == null) { await _chooseLater(); } ...`; select_ride.dart:1155-1176 `created = await ScheduledRideCheckout.run(...)` with no re-quote before it; scheduled_ride_booking.dart:26-28 `final price = selection.authoritativePriceFor(categoryId, now: now); if (price == null) throw ScheduledQuoteRequiredException(categoryId);`; in_process_mock_client.dart:2173 `'expiresAt': WireTime.format(DateTime.now().add(const Duration(minutes: 2))),`
suggested_fix: Before `ScheduledRideCheckout.run`, reuse `_quoteAfterPickup(ride)` (awaiting `_pinQuote`, re-quoting from the confirmed pickup when stale) and pass its price, mirroring `_bookNow`.

title: After a confirmed pickup-pin move, other categories (and the selected one when its pin re-quote failed) are booked with quotes priced at the original pickup
description: Set pickup only re-quotes the selected category, and only when the pin moves (set_pickup_page.dart:493-507 `if (_isAwayFrom(_center, _routeStart)) { ... unawaited(_requote()); }`). When the rider confirms a moved pin, `_bookNow` stores the new position (`_pickupAddress = spot.address; _pickupPosition = spot.position; _pickupConfirmed = true;`, 1487-1489) but never reloads the list quotes. If the rider then declines the 'Price updated' dialog (1515-1520 returns after `setState`), or returns from Finding Drivers, every other category still holds `authoritativeQuotes` priced from the old pickup, and the tiles show those prices. Tapping Book on such a category passes `_book`'s `quoteIsAvailable` check (the quote is fresh for up to 2 min), opens Set pickup at the NEW position showing `fare: SetPickupFare(totalKr: _priceFor(ride) ...)` (1307-1309, the old-pickup quote), and because the pin does not move nothing re-quotes; `_quoteAfterPickup` returns `_bookableQuote(ride.id)` as long as it is not expired (559-560), so `submitFinding` sends `pickupLat/Lng` of the new point with `quoteId`/`quoteSignedPayload` of the old point. The same happens for the selected category itself when its pin re-quote timed out: `_requoteNow` keeps the old fare (set_pickup_page.dart:534-541), `shown == quote.totalMinor` so no dialog, and the old-point quote is booked. The in-process mock's `_validateQuoteBinding` (in_process_mock_client.dart:2188-2230) checks id, signature, expiry, total and category but not the pickup, so the booking is accepted at the wrong price. `_bookScheduled` has the same shape: it never awaits `_pinQuote`, so a pin re-quote still in flight when Set pickup pops (it waits at most 3 s) leaves `ScheduledRideCheckout.draftFrom` → `quotedPrice` on the old-point quote.
failure_scenario: Rider picks Economy, taps Book, drags the pin 1.5 km in Set pickup, confirms, gets 'Price updated 310 kr (was 259 kr)', taps Not now. List now shows Comfort at the price quoted for the original pickup. Rider taps Comfort → Book → Set pickup opens at the new pin showing the old-pickup price → Confirm and search → ride is created at the new coordinates with the old-pickup quote and price; Finding/Waiting then show that price.
evidence: select_ride.dart:1487-1489 `_pickupAddress = spot.address; _pickupPosition = spot.position; _pickupConfirmed = true;` (no `_loadQuotes()`); select_ride.dart:1515-1520 `if (shown != null && _selection.moneyOf(shown).amountMinor != quote.totalMinor && !await _acceptNewPrice(shown, authoritativePrice)) { if (mounted) setState(() {}); return; }`; select_ride.dart:559-560 `final current = _bookableQuote(ride.id); if (current != null) return current;`; select_ride.dart:1307-1309 `fare: SetPickupFare( totalKr: _priceFor(ride),`; set_pickup_page.dart:493-507 requote only inside `if (_isAwayFrom(_center, _routeStart))`; in_process_mock_client.dart:2188-2230 `_validateQuoteBinding` has no pickup check.
suggested_fix: After a confirmed pin move (and on 'Not now'), call `_loadQuotes()` so every category is re-priced from `_pickupPosition`; in `_quoteAfterPickup`, treat a quote whose pickup point differs from the confirmed one (or a failed pin re-quote) as unavailable and re-quote before booking; have `_bookScheduled` await `_pinQuote` the way `_bookNow` does.

title: Wallet split line is computed from the SEK list price for a pickup priced in another currency before the quote arrives
description: `_rideTile` shows `_walletLine(price)` whenever `walletSplitFor(moneyOf(price).amountMinor).usesWallet`, where `price = _priceFor(ride)` falls back to `ride.price` (the SEK catalog figure) when no quote is held. The price text itself is guarded by `_hasPrice(ride)` and shows '…' for a pickup whose zone currency differs from the list's, but the wallet line is not guarded, so for a EUR pickup with a EUR wallet balance the selected tile reads e.g. 'Wallet −50 € · you pay 209 €' built from the 259 kr list price while the price shows '…'.
failure_scenario: Rider in Paris with 50 € in the EUR wallet opens Select Ride; before quotes land, the selected tile shows '…' as the price and 'Wallet −50 € · you pay 209 €' underneath.
evidence: select_ride.dart:2180 `final price = _priceFor(ride);`; select_ride.dart:2304 `_hasPrice(ride) ? _kr(price) : '…',`; select_ride.dart:2334-2340 `if (selected && _selection.walletSplitFor(_selection.moneyOf(price).amountMinor).usesWallet) _walletLine(price),`; ride_selection_controller.dart:498-501 `double priceFor(String id, double catalog, {DateTime? now}) { _discardExpiredQuote(id, now: now); return offeredPrices[id] ?? catalog; }`
suggested_fix: Guard the wallet line with `_hasPrice(ride)` (and ideally with an available quote).

title: Ride check records "Called 112" even when the dialer could not be opened
description: `call112()` catches the dialer failure into `failure` (478-489) but then unconditionally sets `called112: true` and appends `RideCheckAnswer.call112` (495-501), and sends the alert. The answer label "Called 112" is what is saved on the trip and shown in the trip's details (`RideCheckRecord.answerSummary`, ride_check_trip_entry.dart:466) and what the safety team receives, although no call happened; only the transient card note shows `callError`.
failure_scenario: No dialer (web/tablet) or launch refused: card shows a note that the dialer failed, yet the trip details and the submitted answers say "Called 112".
evidence: ride_check_controller.dart:495-502 `_session = latest.copyWith(called112: true, callError: () => failure, answers: alreadyCalled ? latest.answers : [...latest.answers, RideCheckAnswer.call112(_clock())]); _sendAlert();`
suggested_fix: Record a distinct answer (e.g. `call_112_failed`) or omit the "Called 112" answer when `failure != null`, while still sending the alert.

title: Concurrent start(): the failure path cancels the other, still-active recording
description: `start()` guards with `isRecording` (401), which is only true after `_active` is set at the end (426), after two awaits (permission 407, store init 413-415). Two taps in that window both pass the guard; `RideCheckController.toggleRecording` (ride_check_controller.dart:582-613) and the Safety Kit `_toggleAudio` have no busy flag. If the second `_recorder.start` throws (native recorders refuse to start while recording), the catch calls `_recorder.cancel()` on the shared `AudioRecorder`, which cancels and discards the first recording's file, while the first call then sets `_active` and the card keeps showing a running recording whose later `stop()` yields no file (`NO_AUDIO`).
failure_scenario: Rider double-taps "Record audio" on the Ride check card: the mic appears to be recording, but the only recording was cancelled; Stop reports no audio file.
evidence:
safety_audio_service.dart:401 `if (isRecording) {` … :416-425 `try { await _recorder.start(recording.id); } catch (_) { await _recorder.cancel(); await _store.deleteAudio(recording); throw ...`
safety_audio_service.dart:426-428 `_active = recording.copyWith(createdAt: DateTime.now().toUtc());`
suggested_fix: Set an in-flight flag at the top of `start()` (reject or await a second call) and only cancel the recorder when this call's own start had begun.

title: SwedishPhone.toE164 accepts a trunk zero after +46 and stores an invalid contact number
description: After normalising, the function only checks that the part after `+46` is 7–10 digits (116-119). Input like `+46 070 123 45 67` (a very common way to write a Swedish mobile) becomes `+46070…`, which passes (10 digits) and is stored as the emergency contact's `phoneE164` and sent to the share/alert backend, but is not a dialable E.164 number.
failure_scenario: Rider adds a trusted contact as "+46 070 123 45 67"; it is saved as +46070 123 45 67 and shown as such; the number cannot be reached by the safety team.
evidence: phone_e164.dart:115-119 `if (!value.startsWith('+46')) return null; final rest = value.substring(3); if (rest.length < 7 || rest.length > 10) return null; if (!_digits.hasMatch(rest)) return null; return '+46$rest';`
suggested_fix: Strip a leading `0` from `rest` (or reject it), and require the national number to start with a non-zero digit.

title: `_ContactEditorState._save` calls setState in its catch block without a mounted check; the editor is a dismissible sheet
description: `_ContactEditor` is shown through `MoveraSheet.show` (line 42-46) with the defaults `swipeDismissible = true, barrierDismissible = true` (movera_sheet.dart:22-23), so the rider can swipe it away while `await widget.controller.addContact/editContact` is in flight. The success branch guards with `if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);` but the catch branch does `setState(() { _error = ...; _saving = false; })` unconditionally. If the save fails after the sheet was dismissed, `setState` runs on a disposed State: an assertion error in debug ('setState() called after dispose()'), a null-check error on `_element` in release, surfacing as an unhandled async error from the button's unawaited `_save()` future.
failure_scenario: Rider taps Save on the emergency-contact sheet, swipes the sheet down during the request, and the request then fails (offline, server error). The app logs/reports an unhandled 'setState() called after dispose()' error from `_ContactEditorState._save`.
evidence: emergency_contacts_page.dart:284-291 `if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context); } catch (_) { setState(() { _error = widget.controller.error ?? context.l10n.contactSaveFailed; _saving = false; }); }` | :42-46 `await MoveraSheet.show<void>( context: context, builder: (context) => _ContactEditor(controller: _ctl, existing: existing), );` | movera_sheet.dart:22-23 `bool swipeDismissible = true, bool barrierDismissible = true,`
suggested_fix: Add `if (!mounted) return;` at the top of the catch block (mirroring the success branch).

title: Trip-share contact checkbox: failed save is unhandled and leaves preference and contact flags inconsistent
description: The checkbox value is `prefs.tripShareContactIds.contains(id) || contact.shareTrips` (581-585). Its `onChanged` first calls `_ctl.setTripShare(contactIds: selected)` (612-614) and then `_ctl.editContact(contact.copyWith(shareTrips: value == true))` (615-619). `setTripShare` swallows failures into `controller.error` (safety_controller.dart:277-295) and this page never shows `error`; `editContact` has no generic catch, so a transport failure in `SafetyStore._write` (safety_store.dart:92-101 rethrows after restoring the cache) escapes the async callback as an unhandled exception. Because the two writes are independent, one can succeed while the other fails: unchecking a contact may remove the id from `tripShareContactIds` while `shareTrips` stays true, and the `||` keeps the box checked with no message.
failure_scenario: Offline rider unchecks a contact under "Trusted contacts": `setTripShare` fails silently (or succeeds), `editContact` throws unhandled; the checkbox snaps back to checked (or shows checked while the preference list no longer has the id) and the rider gets no error.
evidence:
trip_share_page.dart:581-585 `value: prefs.tripShareContactIds.contains(shareable[i].id) || shareable[i].shareTrips,`
trip_share_page.dart:612-619 `await _ctl.setTripShare(contactIds: selected); await _ctl.editContact(shareable[i].copyWith(shareTrips: value == true));`
safety_controller.dart:239-249 `Future<void> editContact(...) { ... on SafetyException catch (err) { error = err.message; rethrow; } finally { notifyListeners(); } }`
suggested_fix: Wrap the handler in try/catch, show `controller.error`/a toast on failure, and keep a single source of truth (either the preference list or `shareTrips`) so the box reflects one flag.

title: 'CURRENT' button caption on the saved-places location picker is hard-coded English
description: RiderSearchPickupLocation (reached from Add place → pick location, add_place.dart:65) draws the use-my-location button with `TextWidget(text: 'CURRENT', ...)` (:228). No ARB key is used; fr/sv riders see the English caption on the Saved places flow.
failure_scenario: French rider adds a saved place and opens the location picker: the GPS button reads 'CURRENT'.
evidence: pickup_location.dart:227-229 `TextWidget(\n                                    text: 'CURRENT',\n                                    fontSize: 8,`
suggested_fix: Use a localized caption (e.g. context.l10n.currentLocation shortened or a new key).

title: Book-for-later pickup field is pre-filled with the English string 'Current location'
description: The pickup TextEditingController is created with `text: 'Current location'` (:57-58) and that controller is bound directly to the visible address field `_scheduleAddressField(controller: _pickupController, ...)` (:350-351). There is no L10n.place on the controller text, so the first thing the rider sees in the pickup box is English in fr/sv. The same literal is passed as the initial address of ConfirmPickupSpot at :184 (`? 'Current location'`), which then shows it raw (see the ConfirmPickupSpot finding). The screen is covered by test/l10n/l10n_screens_finish_test.dart ('Schedule a ride'), but that test only asserts one translated string is present and cannot notice the English default.
failure_scenario: Swedish rider opens 'Boka senare': the 'Upphämtning' field shows 'Current location' instead of 'Nuvarande plats'.
evidence:
schedule_ride.dart:57-58 `final TextEditingController _pickupController = TextEditingController(
    text: 'Current location',
  );`; :350-351 `_scheduleAddressField(
                            controller: _pickupController,`
suggested_fix: Initialise the controller with L10n.current.currentLocation (and treat that translated value, or an empty value, as the 'current location' sentinel in resolveScheduledPoint), or keep the field empty and show the translated hint.

title: Continue button stays disabled as "Continuing…" after returning from the category cards
description: `_goNext` sets `_continuing = true` (line 126) before calling `widget.onConfirm()` and nothing ever resets it. In `ScheduleRide` the selector is embedded (schedule_ride.dart:257-267) with `onConfirm: goToNextStep`, which pushes the category selector and, when the rider comes back without booking, just does `setState` (schedule_ride.dart:148-151). The rebuilt `ScheduleDateTimeSelector` is the same widget type at the same tree position, so its State (and `_continuing == true`) is kept. The button is built with `enabled = legal && !_continuing` (757) and label `_continuing ? continuing : continueLabel` (809). Reproduced with a throwaway widget test: after one tap and `onConfirm` returning, `ElevatedButton.enabled == false`, label `Continuing…`, and a second tap does not call onConfirm again (`AUDIT continue enabled after return: false; label: Continuing…` / `AUDIT confirms after second tap: 1`).
failure_scenario: Rider on Plan your ride -> Continue -> category cards -> taps back to change the time. The time screen now shows a greyed "Continuing…" button that never re-enables; the only way out is Back to the address step and re-confirming the pickup pin.
evidence:
select_date_time.dart:126-136 `_continuing = true; _pickupCorrectionMessage = null; _commitSchedule(); if (widget.popOnConfirm) {...} setState(() {}); widget.onConfirm();`
select_date_time.dart:757 `final enabled = legal && !_continuing;`
select_date_time.dart:809 `_continuing ? context.l10n.continuing : context.l10n.continueLabel`
schedule_ride.dart:148-151 `} finally { _nextInFlight = false; if (mounted) setState(() {}); }`
suggested_fix: Make `onConfirm` a `Future<void>` and reset `_continuing = false` (with setState) when it completes, or reset it in `didUpdateWidget`/when the route becomes current again.

title: "Arrive by" mode books the chosen arrival time as the pickup time
description: The scheduling screen offers two modes, "Pickup at" and "Arrive by" (`_modeSelector`, lines 585-608 toggle only `_pickupMode`). In "Arrive by" mode the estimate row shows `_selectedDateTime.subtract(trip)` as the "Estimated pickup" (lines 484-488, 726-749), so the rider understands the chosen time is their arrival. But the time committed to the session is always `_selectedDateTime` itself: `_commitSchedule()` (153-158) calls `captureSchedule(_selectedDateTime, ...)` and the `popOnConfirm` path returns `_selectedDateTime` (130-132). `_pickupMode` is never read anywhere else in the file. The committed time becomes `ScheduledRideSession.scheduledAt` -> `SelectRide.initialScheduledFor` -> `ScheduledRideCheckout.draftFrom(scheduledPickupAt: when)` (scheduled_ride_checkout.dart:21-31), i.e. the pickup time of the reservation.
failure_scenario: Rider taps "Arrive by", picks 10:00 for a 20-minute trip; screen says "Estimated pickup 09:40". The reservation is created with scheduledPickupAt = 10:00; Home chrono counts down to 10:00 and the driver is dispatched for a 10:00 pickup, so the rider arrives at ~10:20 instead of by 10:00.
evidence:
select_date_time.dart:82 `bool _pickupMode = true;`
select_date_time.dart:130-132 `if (widget.popOnConfirm) { Navigator.pop(context, _selectedDateTime); return; }`
select_date_time.dart:153-158 `void _commitSchedule() { widget.session?.captureSchedule(_selectedDateTime, timezone: widget.timeZone); }`
select_date_time.dart:484-488 `final estimatedTime = trip == null ? null : _pickupMode ? _selectedDateTime.add(...) : _selectedDateTime.subtract(Duration(minutes: trip));`
scheduled_ride_checkout.dart:31 `scheduledPickupAt: when,`
suggested_fix: When `_pickupMode == false` and `tripMinutes` is known, commit/return `_selectedDateTime.subtract(Duration(minutes: trip))` (clamped with `clampPickup`) as the pickup; hide the Arrive-by mode when `tripMinutes` is null.

title: Untranslated labels on the scheduling screens and in the reservation realtime adapter
description: Literal English in localized screens: `'24-hour'` caption on the time sheet (342); `'SCHEDULE'` header (schedule_ride.dart:305); `'Current location'` as the pickup field's initial text and label (schedule_ride.dart:58, 184; scheduled_category_gate.dart:411 — note `resolveScheduledPoint` also uses it as a sentinel at 490, so a translation must keep the sentinel separate); and `message = 'Your driver has arrived at the pickup point.'` emitted with the driverArrived signal (reservation_ride_realtime.dart:197).
failure_scenario: French rider opens Schedule: header "SCHEDULE", pickup field "Current location", time sheet "24-hour" all in English while the rest of the page is French.
evidence:
select_date_time.dart:342 `'24-hour',`
schedule_ride.dart:305 `'SCHEDULE',`
schedule_ride.dart:57-59 `TextEditingController(text: 'Current location')`
reservation_ride_realtime.dart:197 `message = 'Your driver has arrived at the pickup point.';`
suggested_fix: Move these to ARB keys; keep an internal sentinel constant for the "current location" pickup rather than comparing the displayed text.

title: L10n.place never translates the 'Pickup location' fallback label, so it shows in English on every later screen
description: L10n.place only maps 'Current location' and 'Location off, set pickup'. The third app-generated sentinel, `pickupLocationFallbackLabel = 'Pickup location'` (pickup_address.dart:6), is returned by confirmedPickupAddress/bookingPickupAddress (:46-49, :69) as the ride's pickup label and is therefore shown through shortenPlace/compactAddress (place_format.dart:8) on Finding, Waiting, History and Support untranslated, although an ARB key `pickupLocation` ('Lieu de départ', 'Upphämtningsplats') exists. Reproduced: L10n.use('fr'); shortenPlace(pickupLocationFallbackLabel) == 'Pickup location' while L10n.current.pickupLocation == 'Lieu de départ'.
failure_scenario: Reverse geocoding fails for the confirmed pin → the ride is booked with label 'Pickup location'; the French rider sees 'Pickup location' as the pickup on the Finding/Waiting sheet, in History and in Support instead of 'Lieu de départ'.
suggested_fix: Add `'Pickup location' => current.pickupLocation` to L10n.place.

title: Fractional amounts and distances always use '.' as decimal separator in fr/sv
description: formatMoney writes non-whole SEK as '35.50 kr' (:31-33) regardless of locale, while EUR/TND are hand-converted to a comma (:35, :37), so the app itself treats the comma as the correct separator yet shows Swedish kronor with a dot (sv locale expects '35,50 kr').
